title_sq: Apartament 2+1+Post Parkimi per shitje te Ish-Fusha e Aviacionit
description_sq:
Apartament 2+1+ post parkimi per shitje tek ish fusha e aviacionit. Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje kompleksin Garden residence Turdiu, ne katin e 9 te nje pallati te sapo perfunduar. Orientimi eshte nga jugu me pamje te lire dhe ka nje planimetri shume te rregullt dhe te shfrytezueshme ne te gjitha hapsirat.
Ne cmim perfshihet dhe nje post parkimi ne katin -2.
title_en: Apartment 2+1+Parking Post for sale in the Former Aviation Field
description_en: Apartment 2+1+ parking post for sale at the former aviation field. The apartment is located in a Turdiu Garden residence complex, on the 9th floor of a newly completed building. The orientation is from the south with a free view and it has a very regular and usable floor plan in all spaces. The price includes a parking space on the -2nd floor.
